name: Perplexity Labs
tagline: Perplexity Labs is the experimental arm of Perplexity AI, where the company ships its most advanced features before broader rollout. It includes Deep Research — an autonomous agent that conducts multi-step web research over several minutes and produces comprehensive reports — as well as Perplexity's own R1-style reasoning models. Pro subscribers get early access to Labs features, making it a destination for power users who want the cutting edge of AI-assisted research before it becomes mainstream.
